verdict.rationale: Fastmail is an email and calendar service, so sharing availability or inserting bookable slots into an email is a fair question to ask of it. The pack, however, only offers a bare title for 'Calendar events and invitations' and a community note about calendar syncing. Neither shows a scheduling-link, free/busy-sharing, or bookable-times-in-compose feature, and sending event invitations is an adjacent capability that earns no credit here.
